newsitem.title: USA: Sunstone to buy Kahler Realty for $322 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sunstone to buy Kahler Realty for $322 mln.

text.p: Sunstone Hotel Investors Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to buy Kahler Realty Corp from affiliates of Westbrook Partners LLC for $322 million.
Kahler owns and operates 17 hotels, including 4,255 rooms primarily in Utah, Idaho, Montana and Arizona and Minnesota.
Sunstone president and chief executive Robert Alter said he expects the acquisition to be accretive to FFO per share in 1998, although he did not specify by how much.
Officials at the company were not immediately available to comment.
The transaction is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 1997, the company said.
The acquisition of Kahler brings Sunstone's room total to 9,021, the company said.
